sub_graphs.title: Prague EVM Environment: Data Copy Operations
sub_graphs.description: Models CALLDATACOPY, CODECOPY, RETURNDATACOPY with memory expansion and copy gas

nodes.label: Copy Operation Requested
nodes.description: CALLDATACOPY, CODECOPY, or RETURNDATACOPY invoked

nodes.label: Pop Copy Parameters
nodes.description: Pop destOffset, offset, and size from stack

nodes.label: Calculate Memory Expansion Gas
nodes.description: Compute gas for expanding memory to destOffset + size

nodes.label: Calculate Copy Gas
nodes.description: Compute GAS_COPY * ceil(size / 32) words

nodes.label: Charge Total Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_VERY_LOW + copy_gas + expansion_gas

nodes.label: Validate Return Data Bounds
nodes.description: For RETURNDATACOPY: check offset + size <= returndatasize

nodes.label: Copy Data to Memory
nodes.description: Write source data to memory at destination offset

nodes.label: Copy Operation Complete
nodes.description: Data copied to memory successfully

nodes.label: Return Data Out of Bounds
nodes.description: RETURNDATACOPY attempted read beyond return buffer

nodes.description: BLOBHASH or BLOBBASEFEE instruction fetched

nodes.label: Pop Blob Index
nodes.description: For BLOBHASH: pop index from stack

nodes.label: Check Blob Index Bounds
nodes.description: Verify index < len(blob_versioned_hashes)

nodes.label: Read Blob Versioned Hash
nodes.description: Retrieve versioned hash at index from transaction environment

nodes.label: Read Blob Base Fee
nodes.description: Read current blob base fee from block environment

nodes.label: Blob Hash Returns Zero
nodes.description: Index out of bounds, return zero

nodes.label: Blob Value Pushed
nodes.description: Blob hash or base fee pushed to stack

ambiguities.text: EXTCODEHASH 'returns keccak256 of bytecode; empty accounts yield zero' but the distinction between empty and non-existent accounts is not fully clarified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume empty accounts (balance=0, nonce=0, code=empty) return zero, same as non-existent accounts

ambiguities.text: GAS_WARM_ACCESS and GAS_COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS constants are referenced but exact values not specified in this module
RETURNDATACOPY 'with bounds checking' but the exact error handling (revert vs exception) is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume out-of-bounds access causes execution revert, consuming all remaining gas

implicit_assumptions.description: Execution context values (address, caller, origin) are correctly set by the EVM before instruction execution
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect context could allow contracts to impersonate other addresses or misidentify callers

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot manipulate the access list state to avoid cold access gas costs
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Gas cost evasion could enable DoS attacks by making state access cheaper than intended

implicit_assumptions.description: Blob versioned hashes array is correctly populated from the transaction before execution
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Missing or incorrect blob hashes could break data availability verification

implicit_assumptions.description: Return data buffer is cleared/set correctly between CALLs and is not accessible across transaction boundaries
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Stale return data could leak information between transactions or contract calls

implicit_assumptions.description: Non-existent accounts return balance=0 without triggering access list gas for the query
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different gas costs for querying non-existent vs empty accounts could leak information
